# Result DOM evidence

Captured 2026-11-18 in an isolated Playwright browser using ordinary visible controls and explicitly labeled synthetic data. These are sanitized excerpts from **real result pages**, not clinical accuracy assertions. Patient fields, inputs, scripts, generated IDs, style attributes and unrelated navigation were removed. Result classes, table headers, printed measurements and row marker classes were retained.

- `regular-live.html`: `/result_regular`, bilateral results; OD spherical power 21 selected through the result table UI (`tr.selected`).
- `complex-live.html`: `/result_complex`, OD Myopic LVC, target -0.50, pre-LVC radius 7.80 mm and corrected ametropia +4.00 D entered according to the visible magnitude instruction.
- `second-live.html`: `/result_second`, OD current-eye result plus separately printed contralateral measurements. The `.iol-results` table is the explicitly labeled unadjusted comparison; `.iol-v2-results` contains the Second Eye result.
- `toric-live.html`: `/result_toric`, reached after a normal synthetic spherical calculation and explicit power selection. The single spherical row is context for the cylinder table. `td.bg-blue` indicates the site's highlighted cylinder row. `RESIDUAL AXIS (°)` is not an implantation axis.

The regular/Toric result prints target zero as `-- D`; it is intentionally treated as unknown. Lens model is not echoed in these result cards and is left empty rather than copied from an input selector.

ESCRS: after explicit authorization, terms were accepted normally and a complete synthetic bilateral case was submitted with Alcon AcrySof SN60WF selected for both eyes (target 0 / -0.50). The user completed reCAPTCHA manually. `escrs-regular-live.html` preserves the real `#pdfContent` eye cards, summary tables, matrix cells, constants and per-cell `is-target` markers. Patient/surgeon headers, unrelated page content and inputs were removed. The original live tab was not edited, reset or navigated during preservation.

The regular result remains at `/`. Six formula columns returned for each eye (12 groups / 72 nonempty cells); every raw power/value pair was compared against the preserved original live DOM. `escrs-regular-evidence.json` records that parity and the source's partial failures: Barrett displayed a service-call error and has no result column. OD Cooke K6 at +21.00 displays the malformed string `-+0.00`; the raw value and highlighted state are preserved, with numerical refraction omitted. It is never converted to zero. These observations verify result transfer, not clinical formula accuracy.

`escrs-mixed-special-live.html` is a second real result page, after the user manually completed verification/calculation for an OD Toric / OS Myopic LVC synthetic case. It retains 14 source groups and 70 nonempty rows: 49 spherical-equivalent rows and 21 cylinder-result rows. `escrs-special-evidence.json` records per-formula parity against the preserved original DOM. OD Toric markup has no regular eye wrapper, so exact visible OD/OS headings under `#pdfContent` delimit the source sections. Chart graphics were removed from the fixture; no chart coordinates or private chart state are used.

The Toric table has explicit formula headers spanning two columns, subheaders `IOL Cyl.`, `IOL Axis` and `Res. Cyl.`, and each formula's implant-axis cell spans all eight cylinder steps. Those spans are validated before carrying the printed axis to later rows. `1.50 (T3)` supplies cylinder magnitude and a source model variant; `+0.23 x 90° ↺` supplies residual cylinder/axis and a raw rotation marker, not a new implant axis. Cylinder rows remain separate from the spherical matrix and do not inherit a guessed spherical IOL power. The printed SIA angle matches the separately labeled `Incision @ 180°` legend and the preserved pre-calculation Incision control; under explicit `OPTION: Toric`, it is retained as the incision-axis echo with a 0–360° range.

OS prints `OPTION: Post LASIK/PRK/RK` and the exact eye-scoped note `This calculation is only valid for patients who underwent prior MYOPIC LASIK/PRK.` Only that explicit note establishes `lvcType: myopic`; a generic LVC option alone does not. OD Kane at +21.50 has another literal `-+0.00` cell, preserved raw without numerical refraction. Original browser result tabs were never reset, edited or re-submitted while these excerpts were read.
